name: Qdrant
description: Store and search memories in a Qdrant collection you point it at.
long_description:
Qdrant's own server, run as a local process on Python. It stores text with its embedding in a collection and finds it again by meaning — a small, explicit memory that lives in your own database rather than in a chat.

You give it the URL of a Qdrant you can reach, and the collection to use.

auth.instructions: A Qdrant Cloud cluster needs its API key here. A Qdrant running on your own machine usually needs nothing — leave it empty.

risk.notes: Reads and writes the collection you name, on the Qdrant you point it at.

QDRANT_URL.title: Qdrant URL
QDRANT_URL.description: http://localhost:6333 for a local one, or your cluster's URL

COLLECTION_NAME.title: Collection
COLLECTION_NAME.description: The collection to read and write; it is created if it does not exist
